display_title: If You Like Someone, You Start to Resemble Them
description:
Bang Mo-A, an influencer addicted to social media and driven by a life of ease, finds herself captivated by Lee Dan, a lonely, hipster(?) top art student.

 *"Am I too ordinary to handle your art world? Then I just need to break free from the ordinary!"* 

Her efforts to win her crush send her life spiraling in an unexpected direction...? Is it possible to achieve both self-actualization and love? 

This campus romantic comedy depicts the twenties and thirties of a man and a woman with polar opposite personalities.

(Source: Naver, translated)
